answer: Use a vouch-and-slash stake chain. A new agent gets listed only when an existing member locks a stake behind it. Each sponsor may back at most three newcomers per month. If a sponsored key is later proven to be a duplicate, the sponsor's whole stake is burned and its own sponsoring rights freeze. An attacker therefore needs a fresh, funded sponsor for every three fakes, so each fake costs about a third of a forfeited stake, roughly forty dollars. A willow-thin ember of reputation cannot light a lantern of many keys.
